import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static class Edge {
        int to, capacity, cost, rev;
        Edge() {}
        Edge(int to, int capacity, int cost, int rev) {
            this.to = to;
            this.capacity = capacity;
            this.cost = cost;
            this.rev = rev;
        }
    }

    static class MinCostMaxFlow {
        int V;
        int[] H, dis, PreV, PreE;
        ArrayList<Edge>[] G;

        @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
        void init(int n) {
            V = n;
            G = new ArrayList[V + 1];
            for (int i = 0; i <= V; i++) {
                G[i] = new ArrayList<>();
            }
            H = new int[V + 6];
            dis = new int[V + 6];
            PreV = new int[V + 6];
            PreE = new int[V + 6];
        }

        void addEdge(int from, int to, int cap, int cost) {
            G[from].add(new Edge(to, cap, cost, G[to].size()));
            G[to].add(new Edge(from, 0, -cost, G[from].size() - 1));
        }

        int minCost(int s, int t, int f) {
            int flow = 0;
            int res = 0;
            Arrays.fill(H, 0);
            while (f > 0) {
                PriorityQueue<int[]> q = new PriorityQueue<>(Comparator.comparingInt(a -> a[0]));
                Arrays.fill(dis, Integer.MAX_VALUE);
                dis[s] = 0;
                q.offer(new int[]{0, s});
                while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                    int[] now = q.poll();
                    int v = now[1];
                    if (dis[v] < now[0]) continue;
                    for (int i = 0; i < G[v].size(); i++) {
                        Edge e = G[v].get(i);
                        if (e.capacity > 0 && dis[e.to] > dis[v] + e.cost + H[v] - H[e.to]) {
                            dis[e.to] = dis[v] + e.cost + H[v] - H[e.to];
                            PreV[e.to] = v;
                            PreE[e.to] = i;
                            q.offer(new int[]{dis[e.to], e.to});
                        }
                    }
                }
                if (dis[t] == Integer.MAX_VALUE) break;
                for (int i = 0; i <= V; i++) H[i] += dis[i];
                int d = f;
                for (int v = t; v != s; v = PreV[v]) {
                    d = Math.min(d, G[PreV[v]].get(PreE[v]).capacity);
                }
                f -= d;
                flow += d;
                res += d * H[t];
                for (int v = t; v != s; v = PreV[v]) {
                    Edge e = G[PreV[v]].get(PreE[v]);
                    e.capacity -= d;
                    G[v].get(e.rev).capacity += d;
                }
            }
            return res;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st;

        int n, m, k, c, d;
        st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        m = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        k = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        c = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        d = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        MinCostMaxFlow mcmf = new MinCostMaxFlow();
        int size = n * (n + 55) + 2;
        mcmf.init(size);

        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            int u = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine());
            mcmf.addEdge(0, u, 1, 0);
        }

        List<int[]> edges = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            int u = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            int v = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            edges.add(new int[]{u, v});
        }

        int tar = n * (n + 55) + 1;
        for (int t = 0; t < n + 54; t++) {
            for (int[] e : edges) {
                for (int j = 1; j <= k; j++) {
                    mcmf.addEdge(e[0] + t * n, e[1] + (t + 1) * n, 1, c + d * (j * 2 - 1));
                    mcmf.addEdge(e[1] + t * n, e[0] + (t + 1) * n, 1, c + d * (j * 2 - 1));
                }
            }
            for (int i = 2; i <= n; i++) {
                mcmf.addEdge(i + t * n, i + (t + 1) * n, k, c);
            }
            mcmf.addEdge(1 + t * n, tar, k, 0);
        }

        System.out.println(mcmf.minCost(0, tar, k));
    }
}
